criteria.statement: Bahia resolves a non-zero, service-owned mirror-read secret reference before publication and fails closed when configuration, resolution, value, or ownership is invalid.
The Loom kind-5100 request contains exactly HIVE_CI_GIT_USERNAME and HIVE_CI_GIT_PASSWORD as NIP-44 ciphertext decryptable by only the capability-selected trusted worker.
The clone URL contains no credential and is pinned to the configured fleet Gitea origin and selected mirror path; no credential plaintext appears in events, logs, or errors.
Queued evidence records only the opaque mirror-read credential UUID, while exact request replay does not re-resolve, re-encrypt, or duplicate the Loom dispatch.
Capability-gated trusted-worker selection, no-payment behavior, service-key kind-5401 publication, and trusted worker-signed kind-5402 semantics remain unchanged.
